steps.say: X-linked agammaglobulinemia, Bruton disease, results from mutations in Bruton tyrosine kinase, leading to arrest of B-cell development at the pre-B stage. Patients present after six months of age with profound panhypogammaglobulinemia, absence of mature CD19 B cells in peripheral blood, absent tonsils, and recurrent sinopulmonary encapsulated bacterial infections. Without B cells there are no antibodies.
steps.tx: **X-linked agammaglobulinemia** (Bruton disease) results from mutations in **Bruton tyrosine kinase** (BTK), leading to arrest of B-cell development at the pre-B stage. Patients present after **6 months** of age with profound panhypogammaglobulinemia, absence of mature CD19+ B cells in peripheral blood, absent tonsils, and recurrent sinopulmonary **encapsulated bacterial infections**. Without B cells there are no antibodies.

rows: After 6 months, as maternal antibody wanes
No mature CD19+ B cells, panhypogammaglobulinemia

steps.say: Common variable immunodeficiency is the most frequent symptomatic primary immunodeficiency in adults. It is characterized by low IgG, at least two standard deviations below mean, plus low IgA or IgM, impaired vaccine antibody responses, recurrent infections, enteropathy, bronchiectasis, non-caseating granulomatous lung disease, and elevated lymphoma risk. Low antibodies with lung and gut damage is the CVID pattern.
steps.tx: **Common variable immunodeficiency** (CVID) is the most frequent symptomatic primary immunodeficiency in adults, characterized by low IgG (at least **2 standard deviations** below mean) plus low IgA or IgM, impaired vaccine antibody responses, recurrent infections, enteropathy, bronchiectasis, non-caseating **granulomatous** lymphocytic interstitial lung disease, and elevated **lymphoma** risk. Low antibodies with lung and gut damage is the CVID pattern.

rows: Low IgG plus low IgA or IgM, poor vaccine responses

steps.say: Severe combined immunodeficiency represents a medical emergency caused by IL2RG mutations, which are X-linked, or adenosine deaminase deficiency. Infants present with failure to thrive, persistent thrush, Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, and profound lymphopenia, requiring curative allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Without T cells there is no defence, and live vaccines are never given.
steps.tx: **Severe combined immunodeficiency** (SCID) represents a medical emergency caused by **IL2RG** mutations (X-linked) or **adenosine deaminase** (ADA) deficiency. Infants present with failure to thrive, persistent thrush, **Pneumocystis jirovecii** pneumonia, and profound lymphopenia, requiring curative allogeneic **hematopoietic stem cell transplantation**. Without T cells there is no defence, and live vaccines are never given.

vis.alt: X-linked, ADA deficient and RAG deficient SCID mechanisms with immunophenotypes, absent tonsils, and no live vaccines warning.
vis.caption: IL2RG, ADA and RAG defects with phenotypes. Transplant is curative; live vaccines are forbidden. Details are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: Chronic granulomatous disease arises from defects in NADPH oxidase subunits, with gp91phox encoded by CYBB on the X chromosome, abolishing the respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent catalase-positive fungal and bacterial infections, including Staphylococcus aureus, Burkholderia, Aspergillus, Serratia and Nocardia, diagnosed via dihydrorhodamine flow cytometry. Phagocytes that cannot spark are unable to kill.
steps.tx: **Chronic granulomatous disease** (CGD) arises from defects in **NADPH oxidase** subunits (gp91phox encoded by CYBB on X chromosome), abolishing the **respiratory burst**. Patients suffer recurrent **catalase-positive** fungal and bacterial infections (Staphylococcus aureus, Burkholderia, Aspergillus, Serratia, Nocardia), diagnosed via **dihydrorhodamine-123** (DHR) flow cytometry. Phagocytes that cannot spark are unable to kill.

vis.alt: Absent oxidative burst on DHR flow cytometry in chronic granulomatous disease, with granuloma and Aspergillus.
vis.caption: Absent burst on DHR with granuloma and Aspergillus. The gene and organisms are in the text, not on the drawing (StewardMD).

steps.say: Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome is an X-linked recessive disorder caused by WASP gene mutations, presenting with the classical triad of microthrombocytopenia with small platelets, eczema, and recurrent sinopulmonary and opportunistic infections, alongside heightened susceptibility to autoimmune hemolytic anemia and lymphoma. Small platelets plus eczema plus infections point to WASP.
steps.tx: **Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome** is an X-linked recessive disorder caused by **WASP** gene mutations, presenting with the classical triad of **microthrombocytopenia** with small platelets, **eczema**, and recurrent sinopulmonary and opportunistic infections, alongside heightened susceptibility to **autoimmune hemolytic anemia** and lymphoma. Small platelets plus eczema plus infections point to WASP.

steps.say: Hyper-IgE syndrome, Job syndrome, is predominantly autosomal dominant caused by dominant-negative STAT3 mutations. Hallmarks include extreme serum IgE levels exceeding two thousand international units per millilitre, recurrent cold staphylococcal abscesses without classic inflammatory signs, pneumatoceles, coarse facial features, and retained primary teeth. Cold boils with sky-high IgE are caused by STAT3.
steps.tx: **Hyper-IgE syndrome** (Job syndrome) is predominantly autosomal dominant caused by dominant-negative **STAT3** mutations. Hallmarks include extreme serum IgE levels exceeding **2,000 IU/mL**, recurrent **cold staphylococcal abscesses** without classic inflammatory signs, pneumatoceles, coarse facial features, and retained primary teeth. Cold boils with sky-high IgE are caused by STAT3.

steps.say: Terminal complement deficiencies, congenital absence of C5, C6, C7, C8, or C9, uniquely impair formation of the membrane attack complex, conferring a selective and life-threatening predisposition to recurrent, invasive, meningococcal and gonococcal Neisseria bacteremia, requiring meningococcal vaccination and prophylactic antibiotics. Late complement gaps are an invitation to Neisseria.
steps.tx: Terminal **complement deficiencies** (congenital absence of C5, C6, C7, C8, or C9) uniquely impair formation of the **membrane attack complex**, conferring a selective and life-threatening predisposition to recurrent, invasive, meningococcal and gonococcal **Neisseria** bacteremia, requiring **meningococcal vaccination** and prophylactic antibiotics. Late complement gaps are an invitation to Neisseria.

rows: Recurrent invasive meningococcal and gonococcal disease

steps.say: Intravenous immunoglobulin replacement therapy at a replacement dose of four hundred to six hundred milligrams per kilo every three to four weeks or equivalent subcutaneous immunoglobulin is the life-saving standard of care in humoral immunodeficiencies, that is XLA and CVID, to maintain trough IgG levels above seven hundred to eight hundred milligrams per decilitre and prevent bronchiectasis. Trough levels are what protect the lungs.
steps.tx: **Intravenous immunoglobulin** (IVIG) replacement therapy at a replacement dose of **400 to 600 mg/kg** every **3 to 4 weeks** or equivalent **subcutaneous immunoglobulin** (SCIG) is the life-saving standard of care in humoral immunodeficiencies (XLA and CVID) to maintain trough IgG levels above **700 to 800 mg/dL** and prevent bronchiectasis. Trough levels are what protect the lungs.

rows: IgG above 700 to 800 mg/dL, prevents bronchiectasis
